title: Four more things people built with Pollinations
summary:
A gallery day: four community projects joined the list, spanning creative tools, games, and JSON-first building.

The project gallery gained JSON Pollinations API, StoryBolt, Coloring AI, and the Time Travel Selfie Portal. Creative tools, a game, and a plain JSON interface: the usual reminder that an API will wander off and become whatever someone needed that afternoon.
